answer: I ran the Bell circuit on the real sirius QPU with 100 shots. The circuit puts H on qubit 0, applies a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, and measures both qubits. The final job ID is 01a15f21-b492-7079-8aa3-c3b02ab7ea30. The counts are 00: 53, 11: 40, 10: 5, and 01: 2. Both bits agreed in 93 of 100 shots, so the agreement fraction is 0.93. Before the real run, I tested the script once on the free sirius:mock alias (job 01a15f21-8a6a-7609-ba1a-9a49309acff8, which returned 00: 100). That test cost no credits. The real sirius job was the only paid job. The script is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-205/scratch/bell.py.
